project_type: PHP monolith web app (no framework) with Tailwind CSS + Vanilla JS frontend
build_system: None - PHP served directly by Apache. No build step required.
test_framework: None - no automated tests. Validation is visual/manual.
test_command: N/A - no automated tests. Verify by checking PHP syntax: php -l pages/branchless.php && php -l pages/va.php && php -l pages/qris_merchant.php
verification_instructions: 1. Run php -l on each modified file to ensure no syntax errors. 2. Verify HTML structure is well-formed. 3. Check that JavaScript functions are complete and no unclosed brackets.
setup_instructions: No setup needed. Files are plain PHP/HTML/JS.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no external package installs, no Docker. Use only AST/syntax validation. Tailwind is loaded via CDN in the layout (already available). ApexCharts loaded via CDN in each page.
contribution_requirements: Self-contained PHP pages with inline JS/CSS. Each page fetches data from API endpoints via fetch(). Follow existing patterns in branchless.php as reference.
key_patterns: 1. API calls use POST to './api/transaksi/' with JSON body containing 'type' field. 2. Filter hierarchy: KONSOLIDASI (all 28 cabang) / KORWIL (subset) / specific cabang. 3. Korwil mapping: Semarang=001-007, Solo=008-014, Banyumas=015-021, Pekalongan=022-028. 4. Existing endpoints: detail_breakdown_transaksi returns MoM data with korwil>cabang hierarchy, yoy_transaksi returns YOY data with same hierarchy. 5. Color themes: branchless=emerald-600, va=blue-600, qris=purple-600. 6. Each page is self-contained with inline <style> and <script> blocks.
directory_structure: pages/ - frontend PHP pages (self-contained with inline JS/CSS). api/controllers/ - backend logic. api/routes/ - API routing. views/ - layout partials (navbar, header, footer).
